summary.text: Nymph of the wandering Maeander who bore Miletus the twin children Byblis and Caunus — the Milesian family at the heart of Ovid's warning tale of unlawful sister-love.

story.text: Near the Maeander's course, Cyane daughter of the river was united with Miletus and bore two children of surpassing beauty — the twins Byblis and Caunus, from whom the spring and the tragedy of Milesian legend would flow.
